title: Dariusz prezentuje tort
description: Dariusz podaje gotowy tort w stronę kamery z ceremonialną powagą.

prompts.image: Native vertical 9:16 comic climax in the same kitchen. Exact Dariusz solemnly presents the exact finished pink heart cake on its cream stand like a sacred relic. Huge correct hands support the stand; cake dominates lower-middle and face fills upper-middle. Identical fully covering opaque pink heart apron and opaque high-waisted red satin athletic shorts; no shirt, hairy shoulders and arms visible, nipples and chest front covered. The red heart on cake and apron rhyme in one frame. Exact photoreal late-1990s Polish TV music-comedy, warm golden backlight and subtle S-VHS/16 mm texture. One person, one cake, no nudity, white T-shirt, text or artifacts.
prompts.animation: 3-second slow ceremonial push-in. Dariusz advances the cake stand a few centimeters toward camera, steadies it, opens his eyes and gives one proud tiny nod. The cake decorations remain fixed and intact. Preserve identity, hands, clothes and kitchen; no dropped cake, cuts, morphing, text or watermark.
